what_happened: Scene: layout/style 2; garlic x2, steak_4 (thin slice lying flat on the upper glass shelf, tilt 53 deg) and steak_5 (thick, lower drawer). First trip: gripper closed on the upper-shelf garlic (veg1) at 99, lifted it (hold 108-204), and turned toward the counter; at ~204-212 the garlic slipped out of the fingers (close event 194 width 0.002 = fingers closed on nothing) and fell onto the robot's own mobile base, where it rode along for the rest of the episode (end z 0.40, visible on the base in the left view 212-300). The policy did not notice: with closed fingers it drove to the counter and made an empty 'place' over the left tupperware (~300-380), then drove back to the fridge (~520-620). From ~620 to 2600 (~1980 steps) it stayed at the fridge without lifting anything: it hovered over the flat upper-shelf steak and closed on air above it at 705, then kept the fingers closed 720-1528 while looking alternately at the lower drawer (garlic + thick steak, 900-1500) and the upper shelf (1640-2100); closed on air again at 1822 (closed 1840-2176). Its only real attempt was on the flat steak (contact 2231-2288): the fingers came down along the slice and closed to 0.01 at 2275 without lifting it. A last close on air at 2558. No item ever reached a tupperware.
causal_chain: garlic slipped from the grasp onto the robot base during the turn (~205) -> empty place at the counter (300-380), trip wasted (~420 steps) -> back at the fridge from ~620: ~1980 steps of hovering with mostly closed fingers (closes on air 705, 1822) and one failed pinch of the flat steak (2275) -> 0 items placed at 2600
self_recovery: It returned to the fridge after the empty place (good), but never re-grasped anything; the one attempt on the flat steak failed and it never tried the garlic or thick steak in the drawer.
